original_claims.claim: DLCM discovers variable-length concepts end-to-end without relying on predefined linguistic units.
original_claims.evidence: DLCM discovers variable-length concepts end-to-end without relying on predefined linguistic units.

original_claims.claim: Hierarchical compression in DLCM fundamentally changes scaling behavior.
original_claims.evidence: Hierarchical compression fundamentally changes scaling behavior.

original_claims.claim: A projection-based adversarial attack method is proposed to validate the vulnerability of DNN-based monocular depth estimation models.
original_claims.evidence: To validate the vulnerability of DNN-based MDE models, this study proposes a projection-based adversarial attack method that projects perturbation light onto a target object.

original_claims.claim: The proposed method employs physics-in-the-loop optimization to account for device specifications and disturbances.
original_claims.evidence: The proposed method employs physics-in-the-loop (PITL) optimization -- evaluating candidate solutions in actual environments to account for device specifications and disturbances -- and utilizes a distributed covariance matrix adaptation evolution strategy.

original_claims.claim: Experiments confirmed that the proposed method successfully created adversarial examples leading to depth misestimations.
original_claims.evidence: Experiments confirmed that the proposed method successfully created adversarial examples that lead to depth misestimations, resulting in parts of objects disappearing from the target scene.

original_claims.claim: Alternative noise initializations with different frequency profiles can improve both optimization and search.
original_claims.evidence: We also analyze the frequency characteristics of the noise and show that alternative noise initializations with different frequency profiles can improve both optimization and search.

original_claims.claim: Noise optimization yields superior results in terms of generation quality and diversity.
original_claims.evidence: Our experiments demonstrate that noise optimization yields superior results in terms of generation quality and diversity.

original_claims.claim: Block-based masked diffusion (BD) exhibits a clear quality--efficiency trade-off across block sizes.
original_claims.evidence: Across block sizes, BD exhibits a clear quality--efficiency trade-off, with small-block configurations retaining much of the predictive performance of AR while enabling substantially faster inference.

original_claims.claim: Increasing the denoising budget yields diminishing returns.
original_claims.evidence: Increasing the denoising budget yields diminishing returns, while alternative decoding strategies provide limited gains.

original_claims.claim: Block diffusion is a viable and computationally attractive approach to longitudinal EHR modelling.
original_claims.evidence: Overall, our results show that block diffusion is a viable and computationally attractive approach to longitudinal EHR modelling, with further improvements in iterative decoding offering a promising route toward closing the remaining generative performance gap.
